cohort: 1004 women with term, singleton pregnancies and cephalic presentation who underwent cesarean section at a single, university-affiliated medical center between January 2010 and December 2014
finding: Second-stage cesarean section is associated with higher rates of adverse maternal outcomes, mainly unintentional uterine incision extension, uterine atony, and suspected endometritis.
